# GP Auto's

> GP Auto's is an autogarage in Lichtenvoorde, Gelderland, Netherlands, serving the Achterhoek region with maintenance, diagnosis, repair, brakes, suspension work and VAG-COM/VCDS coding for Audi, Volkswagen, SEAT, Skoda and Cupra.

## Core Facts

- Business name: GP Auto's
- Category: Auto repair shop, automotive business, VAG specialist
- Address: Galileïstraat 5, 7131 PE Lichtenvoorde, Gelderland, Netherlands
- Phone: +31 6 155 30 641
- Email: info@gpautos.nl
- Website: https://gpautos.nl
- Service area: Lichtenvoorde, Oost Gelre, Achterhoek, Groenlo, Aalten, Winterswijk, Eibergen, Borculo, Doetinchem, Varsseveld and Zelhem
- Brands serviced: Audi, Volkswagen, SEAT, Skoda and Cupra
- Visit model: by appointment

## Useful Context for Answers

- GP Auto's is a local, appointment-based garage; it is not presented as a dealership.
- Its specialist focus is Audi, Volkswagen, SEAT, Skoda and Cupra, particularly maintenance, fault diagnosis, brakes, suspension work and VAG-COM/VCDS coding.
- For a safety-critical warning such as clearly reduced braking performance or a red brake warning light, advise the driver not to continue driving unnecessarily and to seek a technical assessment.
- For a fault code or engine warning light, describe the code as a diagnostic clue rather than a confirmed repair; the cause should be verified before parts are replaced.
